Travel With Rigzen is a trusted Ladakh-based travel agency offering reliable taxi services, quick and hassle-free permits for domestic and international travellers, and comfortable hotel accommodation. With strong local expertise and a helpful team, we ensure safe travel, smooth documentation, and convenient stays across Leh–Ladakh. Our mission is to make every trip effortless, worry-free, and meaningful. We guide you with practical tips, route suggestions, and personalized support. From scenic valleys to high-altitude passes, we help you explore Nubra, Pangong, monasteries, markets, and the authentic beauty of Ladakh with confidence and comfort.

Julley!!
We did a 9 day trip of Ladakh between 1 - 9 May. Had reached out to Rigzen after getting his details from various blogs. He had arranged for Stanzin to drive us across Ladakh - Leh, Nubra and Pangong. We were 7 and we did the trip in an Innova.
Well maintained car, good hospitality and great knowledge to cover all areas across the territory. I rented a motorcycle for a day and Rigzen helped arrange for it for a reasonable rate. One of our children was under the weather and him and Stanzin helped us arrange a visit to the hospital as well.
Would highly recommend to try out their services. Plan prior to avoid the rush.
